newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks marginally higher in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks marginally higher in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were marginally higher in early morning trade on Tuesday, but brokers said most investors were on the sidelines with only hours to go before the start of the U.S. presidential election.
Tokyo markets were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
At 0023 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was 10.78 points or 0.05 percent higher at 20,643.84. Its December futures were unchanged at 20,640.
"The market is waiting for the U.S. elections as well as the domestic political picture to come into focus," a broker at at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
